note: Captured live from A4H 2026-08-07 while two real search-configuration objects existed server-side. Confirms the plural GET .../searchconfiguration/configurations response uses rel="http://www.sap.com/adt/categories/configurations" on each entry's atom:link, NOT rel="self" (contrast transport-search-configuration-created.xml, the singular POST-create response, which does use rel="self"). Both shapes share type="application/vnd.sap.adt.configuration.v1+xml" (the CONFIGURATION_TYPE constant) on the link, which is what walkForConfigEntries now matches on instead of rel.
